A '''hotel''' was located in at least two different locations in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant Underworld]]: At the corner of twelfth and G on [[Level 1312/Legends|Level 1312]], and next to a [[Abandoned munitions warehouse/Legends|munitions warehouse]] on [[Level 1315/Legends|Level 1315]]. [[Color/Legends|Yellow]] signs outside the building read "[[Hotel/Legends|HOTEL]]" in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] script, while a greenish blue Aurebesh sign said "VACANCY" (however, the vacancy sign on Level 1315 was upside-down). There was a [[Holobooth/Legends|holobooth]] outside the hotel on Level 1312, which [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] used to contact her friend [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] while on the run.<ref name="Catch" />
